QuestInfo.name: [Water Thief Monster] Moisturizer?
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the Water Thief Monsters and find this rumored moisturizer.
QuestInfo.2: The Water Thief Monster's moisturizer has the name 'Belle' on it. This calls for further investigation!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\nCan proceed to [Water Thief Monster] Tailing Thieves\r\n

0.0: That sounds weird. Do you think they're stealing water to make those things? Weird. Strange. Suspicious!
0.1: We need to look into this further. You're quite the strong one. Why don't you hunt those Water Thief Monsters and get me some of those moisturizers, right from the source?
0.2: Detectives don't always get to do the smart work. Sometimes you've got to get your hands dirty. Ready?\r\n\r\n#r<< You will be moved to the battle map when you accept. >>

yes.0: Hm... So this must be the rumored moisturizer. This tag says...\r\n#rBelle#k and a heart... What does this mean? Is it a new brand? Let me give it a try.
yes.1: Whoa, this is some good stuff. My skin feels amazing. There's no quality seal in place, so I think it's safe to assume it was not mass-produced. Must be handmade.
yes.2: I must look into it further. Belle... What could that mean? I think this calls for an undercover mission. That's always been one of my dreams! I want to join you, but espionage isn't exactly my forte.
yes.3: Even if I can't be there in person, I feel my heart beating faster already. Talk to me when you're ready for this ultimate mission!

default.0: What, no moisturizer? #rIf you want to return to where the Water Thief Monsters are, forfeit the quest#k and talk to me again.

item.0: What, no moisturizer? #rIf you want to return to where the Water Thief Monsters are, forfeit the quest#k and talk to me again.
